title: "The Final Chapter of the Tianji Record"
next_chapter_hook: "The dawn of a new order has not yet dispelled all shadows. When Chen Ji thought everything had settled, a seal deep within the Tianji Record quietly cracked—the next game's board has already been laid out."

text.content: "When the first light of the new order bathed the Three Realms, Chen Ji gazed into the unsolved mystery deep within the Tianji Record—what he did not know was that fate's chess game had never truly ended. The morning breeze brushed past his slightly pallid face, the joy of the Three Realms' initial stabilization still undimmed, yet another deeper stirring had already crept into his heart."

"The Tianji Record floated above Chen Ji's palm, its golden light more gentle than ever, like an elderly person who had weathered countless storms finally able to rest in peace. Yet just then, that seal deep within the fragment that had never been triggered before cracked open on its own. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul image appeared on the fragment, his expression bearing a rare solemnity."

dialogue.content: "'You have finally reached this point.' Mo Xiansheng's voice was no longer the obscure guidance of before, but carried a sense of release: 'The final page of the Tianji Record requires you to write it. This page is not a prophecy, but your answer.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji stared at the fragment before him, sensing the Heavenly Secrets power flowing within. From the moment he obtained the Tianji Record fragment, he knew it was a double-edged sword—it could peer into Heavenly Secrets, yet each use consumed precious Heavenly Fate. Now, as fate's wheel was about to stop turning, he finally had the chance to personally end this legend."

"The Tianji Record's light began to flow, golden characters streaming past Chen Ji's eyes like a stream. He saw his own past—from a worthless disciple to a chess master orchestrating the world, from a laughingstock废物 to an existence that rewrote the Three Realms' landscape. Each scene was forged in blood and tears, every step a weave of calculation and opportunity."

dialogue.content: "'Chen Ji.' A voice transcending gender echoed from deep within the Tianji Record—that was the Voice of the Heavenly Eye, yet no longer that cold pressure from before, but carrying an unnoticeable anticipation: 'You have walked the path no prophet throughout the ages could complete. Now, I wish to see your final choice.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji felt an invisible force enveloping him—that was Heaven's gaze, also the convergence of will left by observers throughout the ages. Yet he did not retreat; instead, he stared directly at that consciousness transcending all. In this moment, he was no longer a chess piece manipulated by fate, but the true rewrites."

choice.prompt: "Faced with the Tianji Record's final page calling to him, Chen Ji needed to make a decision—this page would define his ultimate relationship with the Tianji Record, and would determine how he faced fate's ultimate proposition."

choices.description: "Carve his complete experience into the Tianji Record, letting later generations know that a mortal body can also overturn heaven and change fate; Heavenly Fate is not to be feared."
choices.visible_reward: "Completely sever the Tianji Record's bond with fate"
choices.risk_hint: "Lose all foresight abilities of the Tianji Record"

dialogue.content: "'Excellent!' Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul image showed a relieved smile for the first time: 'What observers throughout the ages have waited for is precisely this moment. An existence that can surpass prophecy is not a stronger prophet, but one who no longer needs prophecy.'"

choices.description: "Refuse to hand fate over to the Tianji Record, instead rewriting this page with his own will, letting the Heavenly Eye see the possibility of mortals."

dialogue.content: "'Interesting.' For the first time, fluctuation appeared in the Heavenly Eye's voice: 'In hundreds of millions of years, no prophet has ever dared speak such words while facing my existence directly. You... have exceeded my calculations.'"

text.content: "Just then, a blurred image emerged from deep within the Tianji Record—a figure in ancient Taoist robes, whose features bore a three-point resemblance to Chen Ji, yet appeared far more aged and profound. This was the first observer's remnant intention manifesting for the first time in hundreds of millions of years."

dialogue.content: "'I am the First Observer.' That ancient voice carried the weight of time: 'When I left the Tianji Record in the world, it was not to find an heir, but to wait for an existence that could surpass me. Those who can break fate are never stronger prophets, but people who no longer need prophecy.'"

text.content: "A shock ran through Chen Ji's heart—he finally understood the true meaning of the Tianji Record's existence. Observers throughout the ages all viewed the Tianji Record as a tool for glimpsing Heavenly Fate, yet none ever considered—its ultimate purpose was to cultivate an existence that no longer needed it. This was a game spanning ten thousand years, and the one who played the final move was none other than himself."

"A turtle shell phantom emerged within the Tianji Record—that was an ancient divine artifact that accompanied the Tianji Record. Chen Ji finally understood, the turtle shell was not used for divining fate, but as a tool to carve an independent path outside of fate. The direction it pointed to was never Heavenly Secrets from the beginning, but the human heart."

dialogue.content: "'I have waited for you a long time, Chen Ji.' The Heavenly Eye's voice carried a strange warmth—that was emotion revealed for the first time in hundreds of millions of years: 'When you chose to transcend prophecy, you proved the meaning of your existence. Fate is not a shackle, but a stage. And you... have learned how to dance.'"

choice.prompt: "The First Observer's dying words revealed the Tianji Record's ultimate truth, and the Heavenly Eye showed an unprecedented attitude. Facing all this, Chen Ji needed to make his final decision—this concerned not only his own fate, but the future direction of the entire Three Realms."

choices.description: "Thoroughly merge his will with the Tianji Record, becoming a new Heavenly Will, reshaping the Three Realms' order with his own will."

dialogue.content: "'Are you certain?' A hint of worry leaked from Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul: 'Merging with Heavenly Secrets means you will become part of heaven, with no path back.'"

choices.description: "Refuse to become part of heaven, instead continuing to guard the Three Realms with a mortal body, letting the Heavenly Eye witness the possibility of mortals."

dialogue.content: "'...' The Heavenly Eye fell silent for a moment, then let out a soft sigh: 'Is this your choice? Transcending heaven, yet not replacing heaven. Interesting, very interesting.'"

choices.description: "Completely destroy the Tianji Record, severing all Heavenly Secrets power, starting anew as an ordinary person."

dialogue.content: "'No!' Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul suddenly paled: 'Once the Tianji Record is destroyed, it will trigger irreversible Heavenly Secrets backlash. But... if your resolve is firm, I will walk the final path with you.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji closed his eyes, feeling the power surging within the Tianji Record. From a worthless disciple to an existence that rewrote the Three Realms' landscape, this road had been too arduous, yet also walked with a clear conscience. He thought of Su Qingyao's perseverance, of Ye Qing's salvation, of his sister Chen Nian's smile."

"No matter which path he chose, he would not regret. Because true fate was never written by Heavenly Secrets, but by human choice. The Tianji Record could foresee the future, yet could never foresee a heart that never gives up. This was precisely why he surpassed observers throughout the ages."

"The First Observer's dying words echoed within the Tianji Record—that was a vigil spanning ten thousand years, waiting only for an existence capable of surpassing prophecy. And now, this wait finally had an answer. No matter what choice Chen Ji made, he had already proven—fate can be rewritten, Heavenly Fate can be transcended."

dialogue.content: "'Whatever choice you make,' Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul image gradually faded, 'remember—this Tianji Record is merely a tool, and you are the chess player. Let the regrets of observers throughout the ages be ended by you.' The words fell, the remnant soul completely dissipated, leaving only the Tianji Record gently trembling in Chen Ji's palm."

text.content: "In the morning light, the Tianji Record's final page slowly unfolded, golden characters awaiting Chen Ji's brushstroke. This was the Tianji Record's final chapter, also the starting point of Chen Ji's new journey. Whether he chose to merge with Heavenly Secrets, maintain a mortal heart, or part ways with Heavenly Secrets, at this moment he was no longer the worthless disciple manipulated by fate."

"He raised his head, gazing toward that land of the Three Realms bathed in dawn light in the distance. Once he thought obtaining the Tianji Record was fate's blessing; now he understood—the true blessing was his never-giving-up determination. The Tianji Record could peer into fate, yet could never calculate the warmth of the human heart."

choice.prompt: "The Tianji Record's final page had unfolded, awaiting Chen Ji's final brushstroke. This was the thematic elevation moment of the entire book—Chen Ji needed a single sentence to define his relationship with fate. This moment's choice would determine the Tianji Record's final form, and would define the legacy he left for future generations."

choices.text: "'My fate is determined by me, not by heaven'"
choices.description: "Declare the fight against fate with the most resolute posture, inscribing this declaration on the Tianji Record's final page, becoming a spiritual totem for all future generations who resisted Heavenly Fate."
choices.visible_reward: "Become a symbol of overturning heaven and changing fate"

text.content: "The Tianji Record's golden characters suddenly blazed; those six characters were engraved into the fragment like thunder, listed alongside the legacies of prophets throughout the ages. In this moment, Chen Ji's will transcended the boundaries of time, becoming an eternal part of the Tianji Record."

choices.text: "'Fate is a stage, the human heart is the light'"
choices.description: "From a gentler yet more profound philosophical perspective, view fate as a stage for revealing humanity, declaring that the human heart is the power that transcends everything."

text.content: "The Tianji Record's light became gentle and distant, that sentence flowing like a clear spring through each page of fragments. The legacies of observers throughout the ages seemed to find their destination in this moment—not opposition, but transcendence."

"Chen Ji's choice fell, the Tianji Record's final page was finally complete. Golden characters flowed on the fragment, no longer cold prophecies, but carrying Chen Ji's unique warmth and wisdom. From this moment on, the Tianji Record was no longer merely a strange book for peering into Heavenly Fate, but a legend about courage and choice."

"The Tianji Record's light gradually收敛, Chen Ji felt an unprecedented lightness. From a worthless disciple to an existence that rewrote the Three Realms' landscape, from a laughingstock废物 to a chess master who transcended prophecy—along this journey, he had lost much, yet gained what fate could never calculate. That was—true free will."

"Just then, a slight tremor came from deep within the Tianji Record. That was the turtle shell artifact's phantom, resonating with the Tianji Record. Chen Ji felt a surge of information flooding his mind—that was the final legacy left by observers throughout the ages, a secret about the Tianji Record's true origin. It turned out the Tianji Record was not created by heaven, but originated from a mortal's obsession to surpass fate."

"The Tianji Record floated in Chen Ji's palm, its light gradually收敛into a warm golden glow. It was no longer a cold heavenly tool, but an existence carrying the blood, sweat, and will of countless people. From now on, the Tianji Record's legacy would be defined by Chen Ji—no longer a shortcut for peering into fate, but a legend guiding future generations. In the morning light, Chen Ji's figure stood especially tall between heaven and earth."

"The Tianji Record slowly settled into Chen Ji's embrace, the final page's characters gradually fading, yet leaving a faint golden thread on each page's corner—that was a mark never achieved by observers throughout the ages. Chen Ji successfully merged his own experience with the Tianji Record, while maintaining his complete self. The Heavenly Eye's voice rang out once more, no longer imposing, but carrying a gentle farewell."

dialogue.content: "'Chen Ji, your journey has ended.' The Heavenly Eye's voice carried a hint of anticipation not easily察觉: 'But the new Three Realms order has just begun. If you have a continuation... the Heavenly Eye will, from a higher place, await your next game of chess.' Before the words finished, that transcendental consciousness had slowly faded, leaving only Chen Ji standing alone in the dawn light."

text.content: "The new order's dawn bathed the Three Realms. Chen Ji gazed upon this heaven and earth he had personally reshaped, a unprecedented tranquility rising in his heart. From a worthless disciple to an existence that transcended prophecy, he spent his life proving—fate was never a predetermined script, but a blank chapter waiting to be rewritten. The Tianji Record's final chapter concluded, but Chen Ji's story had just begun a new chapter."
